desc: Implement a Fenwick Tree (BIT) that supports point updates (marking a position as occupied) and binary search for the k-th empty position (finding the smallest index where the prefix sum of empty slots equals k).
Read the input N and the array P.
Initialize the BIT with all positions 1 to N marked as empty (initial value 1 for each position).
Iterate from i = N down to 1: use the BIT to find the P_i-th empty position, assign A[position] = i, and update the BIT to mark that position as occupied (set value to 0).
Print the resulting array A from index 1 to N.
